analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: GABA receptors are largely neuronal and are barely expressed in these cell lines, so GABA receptor antagonists should produce little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other GABAergic classes that share the same receptor system and would also be expected to show minimal activity in these cells.
